gaps.sentence: You'd better hurry, ___ you'll miss the flight.
gaps.explanation: 'Otherwise' = if you do not, then this will happen.

gaps.sentence: The film is based ___ a true story.
By the time we arrived, the film ___ already started.
gaps.explanation: Past perfect for the earlier of two past events.

gaps.sentence: I couldn't reach the shelf, ___ how tall I am.
He talks as if he ___ the owner of the place.
gaps.explanation: 'As if he were' — subjunctive for an unreal comparison.

gaps.sentence: It's time we ___ this room a good clean.
She made me ___ my homework before dinner.
gaps.explanation: 'make somebody do' — bare infinitive after the object.

gaps.sentence: The findings will be published in ___ course.
gaps.hint: in ___ course = at the right time
gaps.explanation: 'In due course' = eventually, when the time is right.
